words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the ayah begin as continuation. It attaches the fifth counter-testimony to the four already established in 24:8, and its work depends on the omitted testimony action rather than on a new visible verb. The fused opening into {{ar:ٱلْخَٰمِسَةَ}} ({{tr:al-khāmisata}}) lets the reader hear the fifth item as attached and cumulative before the wrath content is stated.

topics.headline: ayah opens as procedural continuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 24:9 does not restart the scene; it carries the wife's oath sequence forward from 24:8.
topics.reason: The context-window evidence confirms that the fifth counter-oath continues 24:8, so the CRITICAL continuity claims survive.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْخَٰمِسَةَ}} ({{tr:al-khāmisata}}) is the first lexical anchor and names the known fifth slot in the counter-oath sequence. Its accusative case reaches back to the testimony frame from 24:8, so the ayah boundary separates the governing procedure from its fifth item. The feminine definite ordinal points to an implied testimony, not a generic oath, and the variant nominative reading shows how much the case can reconfigure the clause. It also reprises the husband's fifth-oath slot in 24:7, so the same procedural position is shared while the oath content changes. The wider {{ar:خ م س}} ({{tr:kh-m-s}}) field of fifth-parts and fivefold arrangement is useful only as narrowed background: here fifthness is procedural completion, not material division.

topics.headline: accusative fifth reaches back across the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ordinal is not an isolated label; its case preserves the prior testimony action across the ayah boundary.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence says the fifth counter-oath continues the woman's four testimonies from 24:8, so the accusative ellipsis claim is licensed.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word identifies the recognized fifth testimony, with feminine agreement pulling an implied testimony into view.
topics.reason: The definite feminine ordinal and local oath frame support reading the word as the known fifth testimony slot.

topics.reason: The variant evidence is meaningful for contrast, but the canonical local parse remains accusative and boundary-dependent.

topics.reason: The wider root family is coherent as background, but local grammar selects ordinal sequence completion rather than material division.

topics.reason: The repeated fifth-oath frame at 24:7 and 24:9 makes the procedural symmetry explicit.

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) turns the wrath statement into the content of the fifth testimony. It governs {{ar:غَضَبَ}} ({{tr:ghaḍaba}}) as the accusative subject of the embedded clause and keeps the wrath phrase subordinate to {{ar:ٱلْخَٰمِسَةَ}} ({{tr:al-khāmisata}}), while the following condition begins a separate scope. The heavy particle also matters by contrast with the lightened variant: the standard route makes the imprecation a nominal content clause, whereas the variant can open an eventive reading. Its doubled nasal gives the content-clause onset a held pressure before the central wrath word arrives.

topics.headline: wrath clause becomes fifth-testimony content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wrath statement is not a separate assertion; it is the embedded content of the fifth testimony.
topics.reason: Local syntax explicitly makes the particle open the content clause completed by the wrath phrase.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heavy standard particle fixes a nominal clause, while the accepted lightened variant exposes a different syntactic route without replacing the local parse.

topics.headline: geminated onset gives the imprecation weight

topics.reason: The phonetic CRITICAL row is locally tied to the heavy particle and does not conflict with grammar.

words.gloss_range: divine wrath as the accusative verbal noun in the embedded imprecation, bound in construct to the divine name and directed by the following preposition

words.prose: {{ar:غَضَبَ}} ({{tr:ghaḍaba}}) is the standard reading's verbal noun: the wrath itself is placed as the accusative subject of {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}). In construct with {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}), it names wrath from God, not wrath toward God, and the following {{ar:عَلَيْهَآ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhā}}) supplies where that sanction lands. The root's harder physical images can sharpen the felt weight of the phrase, but they stay narrowed; the local sense is divine sanction. Against the husband's curse formula in 24:7, this word makes the wife's fifth oath a parallel but lexically different self-imprecation.

topics.headline: accusative verbal noun names the sanction-state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard reading frames wrath as a named state imposed in the oath content rather than as a narrated event.
topics.reason: The guardrail evidence identifies the word as the accusative subject of the heavy-particle clause and the predicate direction as the following prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: construct phrase makes God the source of wrath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the construct phrase binds wrath to its divine source and blocks reading the genitive as the target of wrath.
topics.reason: The iḍāfa relation is syntactically forced, selecting subjective source relation in context.

topics.headline: legal oath enters the Quranic divine-wrath field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is not ordinary anger language; the construct places the false-oath liability in a recognizable divine-sanction register.
topics.reason: Dictionary and co-occurrence evidence support divine wrath as the locally selected branch.

topics.headline: hardness and weight sharpen but do not replace wrath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a concrete weight behind the wrath phrase, while local syntax keeps that image subordinate to the divine-sanction sense.
topics.reason: The physical branches are real root-family evidence, but the local construct and preposition select sanction rather than rock, swelling, or bodily description.

topics.headline: variant verb recasts state as eventive response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accepted variant can make God the actor who becomes angry, while the local standard form names wrath as a condition in the oath.
topics.reason: The variant is meaningful as contrast, but the aligned local form is the gerund under the heavy particle.

topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give a concrete 24:7 counterpart, and the local word is the lexical pivot of that asymmetry.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in genitive construct relation, source and authority of the wrath invoked in the oath

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes the construct phrase and makes the wrath divine in source and authority. Its genitive case comes from dependency on {{ar:غَضَبَ}} ({{tr:ghaḍaba}}), not from a preposition, so the phrase means wrath from God within the oath. The proper name also anchors the wife's fifth oath to the same divine authority invoked in the husband's fifth oath in 24:7, even as the sanction noun changes. The sound moves from the heavy sanction term into the extended divine-name cadence, matching the syntactic move from wrath to source. Derivational pressures around deity, refuge, bewilderment, and exaltation can color the scene of unresolved human evidence, but the local word remains the fixed proper name.

topics.headline: genitive proper name sources the wrath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sanction is not generic disapproval; the construct phrase assigns it to the named divine authority.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence forces the divine name as muḍāf ilayh of the wrath noun, licensing the source-authority reading.

topics.headline: derivational fields color but do not genericize the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that derivational discussions intensify the turn to God amid unresolved testimony, while the proper-name form keeps the oath anchored to one named authority.
topics.reason: The derivational evidence is meaningful background, but QAC and contextual evidence keep the local form as the proper divine name.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 24:7 and 24:9 share the divine name as the procedural anchor even while curse and wrath differentiate the two oaths.
topics.reason: The concrete paired-oath references support retaining the shared-authority topic.

topics.headline: sound moves from sanction term into divine name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the acoustic movement from the heavy sanction word into the extended divine-name cadence.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is local to the adjacent construct phrase and adds a small but real reader-facing payoff.

words.gloss_range: preposition with feminine singular suffix assigning the wrath phrase to the wife as target and liability bearer

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following conditional particle that shifts from liability to test

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهَآ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhā}}) lands the wrath phrase on its target. The preposition gives the sanction an upon-against-liability direction, while the attached feminine suffix identifies the wife already active in the counter-testimony. That same compact target phrase mirrors the husband's target phrase in 24:7, with the gendered suffix carrying the procedural reversal: sanction is now invoked upon her if the condition proves true. Its final open hā creates a hinge before {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) shifts the ayah from liability phrase to conditional test.

topics.headline: attached feminine suffix identifies the wife
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wife is not renamed but is precisely tracked as the target through the attached feminine suffix.
topics.reason: The cross-reference evidence resolves the suffix to the wife in the counter-testimony, so the target claim is licensed.

topics.headline: upon and legal liability converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition makes wrath feel placed upon and legally charged against her, while local syntax keeps it as the predicate direction of the oath content.
topics.reason: The supplied senses of the preposition support spatial and liability pressure, but the local clause narrows them to the wrath predicate.

topics.headline: suffix shift reverses the oath target from 24:7
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same preposition-plus-pronoun frame from 24:7 is reused with a feminine suffix, marking the move from his self-imprecation to hers.
topics.reason: The concrete 24:7 parallel makes the mirrored target reversal a major structural payoff.

topics.headline: final open syllable pivots into the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sound break between the completed liability phrase and the following condition.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is local and supports the larger transition from imprecation to condition.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle introducing an open protasis that scopes the preceding wrath statement
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) pivots from imprecation to legal condition. The wrath phrase has already been spoken, but this particle makes the final clause control when that liability applies. It also preserves genuine openness: the wording does not endorse the husband's truthfulness, but conditionally tests it. Because 24:7 uses the same conditional frame, the wife's formula answers the husband in parallel syntax while keeping the verdict suspended.

topics.headline: condition retroactively limits the wrath clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition comes after the sanction but governs its applicability.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence explicitly links the conditional clause to the preceding wrath statement as its recoverable apodosis.

topics.headline: open condition avoids turning claim into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle keeps the husband's truthfulness legally open rather than presumed.
topics.reason: The particle is marked as a real conditional, so the CRITICAL uncertainty claims are locally supported.

topics.headline: same conditional frame answers 24:7
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wife answers the husband's fifth oath in 24:7 through the same conditional frame.
topics.reason: The concrete 24:7 echo supports preserving the parallel-formula topic.

words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) is a small verb doing decisive classification work. With {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) and {{ar:ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ṣādiqīna}}), it does not merely say that the husband existed; it tests whether he belonged to the truthful class. The third masculine singular form carries the husband as an implicit subject, while the perfect form treats truthfulness as an already relevant status rather than a future possibility. The broad {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) field of being, cosmos, and place is therefore narrowed into legal status verification inside the paired formula from 24:7 and 24:9, answering the husband's truth claim from 24:6.

topics.headline: being becomes class membership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb turns being into membership in a moral class through the following partitive phrase.
topics.reason: The verb instance is copular and completed by the following prepositional predicate, so the class-membership claim is strongly licensed.

topics.headline: 3ms perfect tests his established status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the subject is the husband carried inside the 3ms verb form, and the condition tests an established status.
topics.reason: The implicit-subject evidence and perfect morphology support the husband-status reading.

topics.headline: broad being-root reduced to legal status verification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a broad root of being, cosmos, and place is compressed here into a legal copular hinge.
topics.reason: The wider root family is real background, but the local construction with the partitive phrase narrows it to classification.

topics.headline: same status frame distributes liar and truthful classes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same status formula answers the husband's claim from 24:6 and his fifth-oath condition from 24:7.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete nearby references and the local syntax matches the formula.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the definite truthful class governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) is the hinge between being and moral classification. It governs {{ar:ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ṣādiqīna}}) and makes truthfulness a class from which the husband may be counted, not a loose adjective attached to a single utterance. Its source or extraction pressure can be heard as being drawn from a set, while the local grammar keeps the partitive reading dominant. Its short nasal form binds directly into the final class noun, keeping the classification phrase compressed in sound and form. The repeated preposition also mirrors the liar-class formula in 24:7, making both sides of the procedure classify by membership.

topics.headline: preposition turns truth into class membership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition makes the husband conditionally one of a class, not simply someone described by an adjective.
topics.reason: The following noun is governed by the preposition as the predicate complement of the status verb, so partitive classification is forced.

topics.headline: source and kind sharpen the partitive relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the husband is grammatically drawn from or assigned to the kind called the truthful, while the local construction keeps membership as the main sense.
topics.reason: The supplied source and genus senses are coherent, but they are narrowed by the locally dominant partitive construction.

topics.headline: same preposition mirrors the liar-class frame in 24:7
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition repeats the exact class-membership mechanism used for the opposing liar class in 24:7.
topics.reason: The concrete 24:7 echo makes the repeated preposition structurally important.

topics.headline: short preposition binds the final class phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the compact preposition keeps the final classification phrase tightly linked in sound and form.
topics.reason: The formal rows are local and reinforce the single classifying phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural active participle, genitive under the preposition, naming the truthful as a recognized class of moral agents

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ṣādiqīna}}) closes the ayah on the class that determines the whole self-imprecation. Its active participle and definite masculine plural form make truthfulness a recognized class of moral agents, while its genitive case keeps it governed by {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) rather than free-standing. The root's core pressure of speech matching reality is directly apt to legal testimony; charity and bridal-gift derivatives add narrowed proof-resonance in this marital dispute without replacing the local truth-class sense. The final word also answers the liar-class term in 24:7 and the husband's truth claim in 24:6, so the ayah lands on classification rather than on wrath alone. Its long īn ending and emphatic opening give that final truth-class landing audible closure.

topics.headline: recognized class of truthful moral agents

topics.reason: QAC morphology and CRITICAL form rows support the active-participial class reading.

topics.headline: genitive form locks the word into the partitive phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is not an independent predicate; it is the governed class into which the status verb places him.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the prepositional complement relation.

topics.headline: speech-reality truth gains proof resonance in marital testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truth here means correspondence to reality, with marital and enacted-proof derivatives resonating as background rather than replacing the class sense.
topics.reason: The root-family proof material is relevant in the marital oath setting, but local morphology selects truthful persons as the sense.

topics.headline: truthful class answers the liar class from 24:7

topics.reason: The concrete 24:7 parallel makes the antithesis central to the ayah's closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَٱلْخَامِسَةَ ... غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا ... إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّادِقِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: A numbered fifth speech act names God and conditionally places the speaker under intense divine displeasure tending toward requital if the implicit masculine subject's claim accords with reality.

activation_trace.role: The literal fifth and one-of-five image makes this a terminal counted act.
Intense displeasure rising toward requital supplies the consequence conditionally invoked upon her.
The divine name in oath usage identifies the transcendent guarantor and judge of the imprecation.
Occurrence or presence in time makes the sanction depend on a state actually obtaining.
Speech matching both inward intent and reported reality defines the condition of truthfulness.

changed_reading.before: A fifth statement says that wrath is upon her if he is truthful.
changed_reading.after: The fifth is a conditional self-imprecation: a counted speech act places her under divine requital only if the implicit claimant's speech matches reality.

baseline_models.mechanism: The occurrence construction and the realization branch of truthfulness keep truth from being manufactured by the utterance: the condition must obtain and be borne out before wrath follows.

activation_trace.role: Actual occurrence supplies the requirement that the conditional state obtain rather than merely be asserted.
Realization of promise or deed makes truthfulness something fulfilled and borne out, not only verbally labeled.
Retaliatory displeasure is the consequence of realized truth, not evidence that establishes it.

changed_reading.before: The condition merely repeats a claim that the implicit subject is truthful.
changed_reading.after: Truth remains a condition to be realized or borne out; wrath follows that realization rather than making the oath itself proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired four-plus-fifth sequences make her clause a counter-oath that averts present punishment without deciding the disputed fact; it transfers exposure into a conditional divine sanction, with curse for his falsehood and wrath upon her if his claim is true.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based declaration supplies the repeated evidentiary speech that precedes the first fifth.
The literal four establishes the preparatory counted layer before the terminal oath.
The paired numerical fifth marks the claimant's terminal self-imprecation.
Expulsion and distancing under displeasure supply the consequence attached to his falsehood.
Contrariety to truth defines the liability pole of the first fifth.
Punitive pain is explicitly warded from her by the counter-testimony, identifying the immediate liability displaced.
Her own numerical fifth closes the counter-sequence while preserving its distinct condition.
Active displeasure tending toward requital replaces the present human punishment with contingent divine exposure.
Correspondence of speech to reality defines the opposite condition under which her exposure becomes live.

structural_cues: 24:6 gives four attestations and a truth claim, followed by his fifth in 24:7.
24:8 says her four attestations ward punishment from her and characterize him as lying.
The two fifths are grammatically paired but invoke different consequence nouns: curse in 24:7 and wrath in 24:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two four-plus-fifth sequences, curse on him if lying, warded punishment, and wrath on her if he is truthful. I infer a transfer of present penal exposure into contingent divine liability and treat the curse/wrath contrast as meaningful; alternatively, the two consequence nouns may function as near-equivalent formulas.

changed_reading.before: Her fifth is an isolated conditional invocation of wrath.
changed_reading.after: Her fifth is the risk-bearing price of the counter-oath: it averts immediate punishment without proving him false, while placing her under divine liability if his claim is true; the paired fifths also preserve a curse-versus-wrath asymmetry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel surrounds the invoked wrath with divine surplus, tenderness, solicitation of return, and discerning judgment, preventing the conditional sanction from becoming an irrevocable identity or an unqualified final word.

activation_trace.role: Retaliatory displeasure remains the serious liability that needs contextual containment.
Favor as gratuitous benefaction supplies surplus beyond the strict liability just invoked.
Tender mercy supplies a restorative counterforce without erasing the oath's consequence.
Calling another toward repentance keeps return live immediately after the self-imprecation.
Accurate wisdom frames the handling of liability as discerning judgment rather than uncontrolled anger.

structural_cues: 24:10 follows the focus immediately with an unfinished لولا construction invoking favor, mercy, return, and wisdom.
The favor-and-mercy refrain recurs through the accusation episode in 24:14, 24:20, and 24:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency and a recurrent favor-and-mercy refrain. I infer that this refrain brackets the focus sanction and leaves restoration possible; alternatively, 24:10 may qualify the procedure or community generally rather than the oath-taker specifically.

changed_reading.before: Divine wrath reads as the terminal and exhaustive outcome named by the oath.
changed_reading.after: Wrath remains a real conditional liability, but the immediate frame withholds finality: divine benefaction, mercy, return, and wise judgment surround rather than cancel it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accusation sequence first exposes mouth-borne speech without knowledge, then transfers testimony to bodily organs and intentional action, and finally has God complete and manifest the right. This defers verification beyond the litigants' oath speech.

activation_trace.role: Truth as realization or fulfillment anchors the focus condition to something that must later be borne out.
Speech that attributes what did not occur demonstrates that utterance can fabricate rather than establish reality.
The tongue as speech organ supplies the fragile human channel through which the unsupported report circulates.
The tongue-as-witness image relocates testimony from chosen allegation to the body's own disclosure.
What the hands have earned makes enacted conduct evidentiary rather than leaving truth at the level of claims.
The literal feet join the distributed bodily witness and broaden disclosure beyond the speaking mouth.
Intentional action supplies the conduct to which bodily testimony answers.
Full completion without deficiency supplies the eventual settlement of the unresolved liability.
Establishing and manifesting the right supplies the disclosure that oath repetition alone cannot produce.
Appearance and uncovering make the final truth manifest rather than merely asserted.

structural_cues: 24:15 contrasts what mouths say without knowledge with its weight before God.
24:24 makes tongues, hands, and feet testify to actions.
24:25 joins full settlement with recognition of God as the manifest truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a movement from unsupported mouth-speech to bodily testimony, action, full settlement, and manifest right. I infer that the focus conditional remains unresolved at the human speech level and awaits fuller disclosure; alternatively, the later scene may concern slanderers broadly rather than the two oath-takers narrowly.

changed_reading.before: The focus oath appears capable of settling which speaker is truthful.
changed_reading.after: The oath allocates liability while truth remains pending: bodily action later testifies, and God completes and manifests the right that ritual speech does not create.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later conditional echo joins possession of the right to willing submission before judgment. Read back into the focus, being among the truthful is tested not by assertion alone but by submitting the unresolved claim and oneself to divine adjudication.

activation_trace.role: The focus occurrence construction supplies the conditional state echoed by the later if-the-right-is-theirs clause.
Correspondence between claim and reality anchors the issue that submission is proposed to test.
Judgment between parties supplies the adjudicative destination to which disputed speakers are called.
The repeated occurrence construction introduces the closely related condition that the right actually belong to them.
A right fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the later analogue to focus truthfulness.
Submission makes the claimant's relation to judgment part of the truth mechanism.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies receptive acknowledgment of judgment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The mirrored fifth oath carries a nonidentical stake.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed-ayah `غ ض ب` B001 is intensified displeasure rising toward retaliation; `ص د ق` B001 is truth in speech and B004 confirmation or fulfillment; `خ م س` B001 marks the fifth. **Structural cue:** 24:7 makes the man's conditional fifth a `لعنة` of exclusion, whereas 24:9 makes the woman's conditional fifth `غضب`; 24:10 immediately suspends the sequence under divine bounty, mercy, and wise restraint. **Assigned role:** wrath gives the counter-denial an active retaliatory stake, balancing but not lexically duplicating the accuser's risk of exclusion. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies formal symmetry and lexical asymmetry; I infer that equivalent procedural weight need not mean identical sanction imagery. **Reading change:** the fifth oath reads as a calibrated counterweight in a reciprocal mechanism, not as a copied formula with a changed pronoun.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 24:10 immediately prevented the lexical asymmetry from becoming an unrestricted escalation: mercy and wise restraint bound both oath-stakes inside a larger arresting frame.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: divine name used in oath `quranic:root_000047:B002/m01`; the number four `quranic:root_000536:B001/m01`; the fifth that completes the series `quranic:root_000439:B001/m01`; mutual imprecation between spouses `quranic:root_001359:B004/m01`; averting a penalty by counter-proof `quranic:root_000466:B001/m01`; wrath surging toward requital `quranic:root_001092:B001/m01`; the self as the sole available witness `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`; punishment as inflicted pain `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 24:6 `إِلَّا أَنفُسُهُمْ ... أَرْبَعُ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ`; 24:7 `وَالْخَامِسَةُ ... لَعْنَتَ اللَّهِ`; 24:8 `وَيَدْرَأُ عَنْهَا الْعَذَابَ`; 24:9 `وَالْخَامِسَةَ ... غَضَبَ اللَّهِ`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The oath procedure is a calibrated counterweight, not a loose appeal to sincerity. Four units establish symmetry; the fifth changes the stakes; the answering sequence actively deflects punishment. Lexical imprecation makes the legal form reciprocal and self-binding.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem bir kişiyle karşılıklı inatlaşmayı hem de bir topluluğa karşı çıkmayı kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşı koyma, inatlaşma ve muhalefet etme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye doğrudan karşı koyma ve onunla çekişme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı inatlaşma ve karşı koyma eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir topluluğa yönelen daha geniş muhalefet durumunu açıkça kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kişiye doğrudan karşı koyma ile topluluğa muhalefet etme, dar ve belirli bir eylem çekirdeğinde birleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Topluluktan ayrılma, uzaklaşma, açık çekişme ve ilişkiyi kesme gibi ek sonuçlara uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da inatlaşarak muhalefet etme ve karşı koyma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal karşı koyma ve muhalefet çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; komşu dal ayrılma, uzaklaşma ve çatışma gibi daha geniş sonuçları da içerdiğinden yalnızca kısmen örtüşür.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: En yakın aday, aynı karşı koyma çekirdeğini taşıyan fakat daha geniş çatışma sonuçlarına uzanan dal olarak seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه غاضبه ومغاضبا بمعنى راغمه ومراغما لقومه.

branches.source_phrase_ar: غاضبه: راغمه؛ مغاضبا أي مراغما لقومه (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kaya referentini açıkça destekler, ancak sertlik, dağda yığılmış olma ve yuvarlaklık bütün örneklerde birlikte bulunan zorunlu özellikler değildir. Dal korunabilir; tanım bu nitelikleri kaynaklara göre değişen betimlemeler olarak ayırmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek belirli bir kayadır; sert, dağda yığılmış ve yuvarlak olma özellikleri tek bir zorunlu birleşim sayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın kaya adını verir ve yapı bağımlı olmayan kaynak betimlemelerini birbirine karıştırmadan sıralar.

concept_map.definition: Sert bir kayayı adlandırır; kaynak değişkelerine göre dağda yığılmış ya da yuvarlak bir kaya olarak da betimlenir.

facets.statement: Temel referent sert bir kaya veya kayaya benzeyen katı bir kütledir.
Bazı betimlemelerde kaya dağda yığılmış, bazılarında ise yuvarlak biçimlidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kaya referentinde birleşirken onu sert, dağ içinde yığılmış, yuvarlak veya genel olarak kayaya benzer biçimde farklı ayrıntılarla niteler.

concept_gloss.text: sert, yığılmış veya yuvarlak kaya
concept_gloss.applicability: Kaya çekirdeğini ve kaynaklarda birbirine seçenek oluşturan başlıca biçim niteliklerini birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Kaya referentini, sertlik çekirdeğini ve değişken yığılmışlık ile yuvarlaklık betimlemelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Biçim ayrıntısının önemli olmadığı ve katılığın öne çıktığı genel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kaya referentini ve onun sertlik niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dağda yığılmış veya yuvarlak olabilen kaynak değişkelerini belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dağda yığılmış veya yuvarlak olabilen belirli kaya betimlemelerini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Büyüklüğü zorunlu kılar ve sert taş ile kayaları daha genel bir sınıf olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da sert ve katı kaya referentini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın yığılmışlık ve yuvarlaklık gibi değişken betimlemeleri vardır; komşu dal ise büyüklüğü öne çıkaran daha genel sert taş ve kaya sınıfını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yalnızca sert kaya çekirdeğini doğrudan paylaşan ve büyüklük kapsamıyla ayrılan en yakın komşu yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kalın derili adamı, kızıl ve kalın adamı, ayrıca çok yoğun kızıllığı destekler. Dal genel beden kalınlığına genişletilmemeli; kalınlık yalnızca verilen kişi nitelemelerinde, kızıllık ise hem bu nitelemelerde hem yalın renk kullanımında tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kalın deri ile yoğun kızıllık seçenekli ve kullanıma bağlı özelliklerdir; bütün referentlerde ikisinin birlikte bulunması gerekmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kişi nitelemelerine bağlı kalınlık anlamlarını, yalın biçimdeki yoğun kızıllık anlamından açıkça ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kişi nitelemelerinde kalın derili olmayı, kızıl ve kalın görünümü ya da çok yoğun kızıllığı bildirir. Yalın biçim de çok kızıl olanı adlandırabilir.

facets.statement: Bir adamı niteleyen özel yapıda derisinin kalın olduğunu bildirir.
Başka bir kişi nitelemesinde kızıllık ile bedensel kalınlığı birlikte verir.
Renk kullanımında çok güçlü ve yoğun bir kızıllığı anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişi nitelemelerinde kalın deri veya kızıllıkla birleşen bedensel kalınlık; renk kullanımında ise çok yoğun kızıllık bildiren bir anlam kümesi sunar.

concept_gloss.text: kalın derili ya da çok kızıl
concept_gloss.applicability: Kullanıma göre değişen kalın deri, kızıl ve kalın görünüm ile yoğun kızıllık seçeneklerini topluca gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Kalın deri nitelemesini, kızıllıkla birleşen kalınlığı ve yoğun renk derecesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Adamın deri kalınlığı bakımından nitelendiği özel kişi yapısında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye yüklenen kalın deri niteliğini tam olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Kızıl ve kalın görünüm ile yalın yoğun kızıllık kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Rengin olağandan belirgin biçimde daha yoğun olduğunu anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kızıllığın güçlü ve yüksek dereceli olmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kalın deri ve kızıllıkla birleşen bedensel kalınlık nitelemelerini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kalın deri ile kızıl ve kalın beden nitelemelerini yoğun kızıllıkla aynı kullanım kümesinde taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişilerin şiddetli kızıllığını deri veya beden kalınlığı katmadan doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insan nitelemesinde yüksek dereceli kızıllığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bazı yapılarda deri ve beden kalınlığını da içerir; komşu dal yalnızca şiddetli kızıllığa odaklandığı için renk bağlamında yakın, bütün dal kapsamında ise kısmi karşılıktır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yoğun kızıllığı doğrudan paylaşan komşu seçildi; genel beden kalınlığı adayları renk çekirdeğini taşımadıkları için yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رجل غضاب أي غليظ الجلد، ورجل غضب أو أحمر غضب بمعنى أحمر غليظ أو شديد الحمرة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الغضب النفسي إلا إذا صار وصفا للحمرة، ولا يدخل فيه ورم العين الخاص أو الصخرة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca sonradan oluşan şişliği değil, üst göz kapağındaki doğuştan bir çıkıntıyı da bildirir. Dal göz çevresiyle sınırlı kalmak koşuluyla korunabilir, fakat tanım doğuştan özellik ile çevresel şişliği birbirinden ayırmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üst kapaktaki doğuştan çıkıntı ile göz çevresindeki veya altındaki şişlik seçenekli durumlardır; genel göz kızarıklığı kapsanmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimdeki kapak çıkıntısını, gözün şişmesini ve kişide göz altı şişliği bulunmasını ayrı kapsamlarla gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Üst göz kapağındaki doğuştan çıkıntıyı veya gözün çevresinde, özellikle altında oluşan şişliği bildirir.

facets.statement: Üst göz kapağında doğuştan bulunan belirgin bir çıkıntıyı adlandırır.
Gözün çevresindeki dokuların şişmesi durumunu anlatır.
Kişi nitelemesinde özellikle göz altındaki şişliği belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar göz çevresindeki belirgin kabarıklıkta birleşir; biri üst kapaktaki doğuştan çıkıntıyı, diğeri göz çevresinin veya göz altının şişmesini açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: üst göz kapağı çıkıntısı veya göz çevresi şişliği
concept_gloss.applicability: Doğuştan kapak çıkıntısını ve göz çevresinde oluşan şişlik durumlarını birlikte kapsayan açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Üst kapaktaki doğuştan çıkıntıyı, çevresel şişliği ve göz altı yerleşimini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gözün çevresinde veya altında sonradan oluşan şişliğin anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göz çevresindeki ve altındaki şişlik durumunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Üst göz kapağındaki doğuştan çıkıntı anlamını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üst kapaktaki yapısal ve doğuştan özelliğin açıklanması gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çıkıntının üst kapakta ve doğuştan bulunmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Göz çevresinde sonradan oluşan şişlik kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: üst göz kapağında doğuştan çıkıntı veya göz çevresi şişliği

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kabarıklığı göz kapağına ve göz çevresine sınırlar; doğuştan bir kapak özelliğini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvanların meme, boyun ve sırtındaki şişlikleri, ayrıca memenin süt indirmesiyle ilgili değişimi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da dokuda belirginleşen şişlik veya kabarıklığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnızca göz bölgesindeki doğuştan ya da sonradan oluşan kabarıklıklara aittir; komşu dal farklı hayvan dokularına ve meme işlevine uzandığından yerine kullanılamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Genel kabarıklık çekirdeğini paylaşan komşu yayımlandı; öteki göz adayları farklı bozuklukları anlattığından yalnızca aynı alandadır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dişi deve veya kadın için somurtkanlık ve huysuzluğu, ayrı bir kullanımda ise büyük yılanı destekler. Büyüklük genel bir kişi veya hayvan niteliği değildir; yalnızca yılan referentine aittir ve tanımda davranış nitelemesinden ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Somurtkanlık ve huysuzluk kadın ile dişi deve nitelemelerine, büyüklük ise yalnızca yılan anlamına bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kişi ve hayvan nitelemelerine bağlı davranış anlamını, yalın biçimdeki büyük yılan referentinden ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Dişi deve veya kadın için somurtkan ya da huysuz olmayı bildirir; ayrı bir kullanımda büyük bir yılanı adlandırır.

facets.statement: Dişi deve nitelemesinde somurtkan ve huysuz bir davranışı anlatır.

Ayrı bir söz varlığı kullanımında büyük bir yılanı adlandırır.

concept_gloss.text: somurtkan, huysuz; iri yılan

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kadının somurtkan yüzü veya ters davranışı bakımından nitelendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Kadın ve dişi deve için kullanılan somurtkanlık ve huysuzluk nitelemelerini kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iri yılan; somurtkan veya huysuz olan

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kadın ve dişi deve için kalıcı bir somurtkanlık veya huysuzluk niteliğini, ayrıca ayrı bir büyük yılan anlamını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Üzüntü, kaygı veya kötü durum nedeniyle yüzün renginin ve görünüşünün değişmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yüzde beliren somurtkanlık ve hoşnutsuz görünüş alanına girer.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yaşlı dağ keçisinin yüzülmüş derisini, kaplumbağa derisini ve katlanarak kalkana benzetilen deve derisi parçasını aynı deri dalında açıkça sayar. Ortak üst sınır hayvan derisidir; hayvan türü ve katlama işlemi alt kullanımları ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca belirli hayvan derilerini ve katlanmış deve derisi parçasını kapsar; kaya anlamına sertlik benzerliğiyle genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın deri adlarını ve bunların hayvan türü ile hazırlama biçimine bağlı alt referentlerini birlikte korur.

concept_map.definition: Belirli hayvanların derisini veya üst üste katlanarak kalkana benzetilen bir deve derisi parçasını adlandırır.

facets.statement: Yüzülmüş yaşlı dağ keçisinin derisini adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin bütün bölümleri, evlilik sırasında kadına verilen veya onun için belirlenen özel malı ve bu anlamdaki biçim çeşitlerini gösterir. Dalın evlilik hakkı çerçevesi, genel mali yardım ya da arkadaşlık anlamlarını dışarıda bırakarak kanıtı doğru sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu mal evlilik ilişkisinde kadına ait özel bir haktır; yoksula verilen yardım, düğün armağanı veya evliliğin kendisiyle özdeş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad kadının evlilik hakkı olan malı belirtir; kadına bu malı belirleme eylemi ve kadınlarla kurulan ad yapıları kendi yapısal sınırlarında korunur.
